# Overview: scripted localisation for the Cortes hemicycle.
# Each dot resolves its own texture from the bloc that holds it, so the chamber repaints
# when spain_cortes_refresh_display rewrites the seat map.
# Generated by tools/build_spain_cortes_hemicycle.py. Lives under
# common/scripted_localisation/ because the engine only reads defined_text there.

 defined_text = {
  name = spain_cortes_dot_1_img
  text = {
   trigger = { ROOT = { check_variable = { var = spain_cortes_dot_1 value = 1 } } }
   localization_key = "GFX_spain_cortes_dot_socialists"
  }
  text = {
   trigger = { ROOT = { check_variable = { var = spain_cortes_dot_1 value = 2 } } }
   localization_key = "GFX_spain_cortes_dot_republicans"
  }
  text = {
   trigger = { ROOT = { check_variable = { var = spain_cortes_dot_1 value = 3 } } }
   localization_key = "GFX_spain_cortes_dot_liberals"
  }
  text = {
   trigger = { ROOT = { check_variable = { var = spain_cortes_dot_1 value = 4 } } }
   localization_key = "GFX_spain_cortes_dot_conservatives"
  }
  text = {
   trigger = { ROOT = { check_variable = { var = spain_cortes_dot_1 value = 5 } } }
   localization_key = "GFX_spain_cortes_dot_monarchists"
  }
  text = {
   trigger = { ROOT = { check_variable = { var = spain_cortes_dot_1 value = 6 } } }
   localization_key = "GFX_spain_cortes_dot_carlists"
  }
  text = {
   trigger = { ROOT = { check_variable = { var = spain_cortes_dot_1 value = 7 } } }
   localization_key = "GFX_spain_cortes_dot_falange"
  }
  text = { localization_key = "GFX_spain_cortes_dot_empty" }
 }
